=== 1. Resistance selection and current ===
Selected series resistor: 330 Ω.
LED forward drop: exactly 2.40 V. Supply: ideal 9.00 V DC.
Voltage across resistor: 9.00 V - 2.40 V = 6.60 V.
Current: I = 6.60 V / 330 Ω = 0.0200 A = 20.0 mA.
This current is within the required range 18.0 mA to 22.0 mA inclusive.

=== 2. Checks of the other resistance choices ===
Available alternatives: 270 Ω and 390 Ω (tolerance negligible).
- 270 Ω: I = 6.60 V / 270 Ω = 0.02444 A ≈ 24.4 mA. This exceeds 22.0 mA, so it fails the current constraint.
- 390 Ω: I = 6.60 V / 390 Ω = 0.01692 A ≈ 16.9 mA. This is below 18.0 mA, so it fails the current constraint.
Only 330 Ω satisfies the current requirement.

=== 3. Dissipation and power-rating selection ===
Actual resistor dissipation with 330 Ω at 20.0 mA:
P = I²R = (0.0200 A)² × 330 Ω = 0.132 W (exact).
Also P = V²/R = (6.60 V)² / 330 Ω = 0.132 W (exact).
Safety-margin requirement: rating must be at least twice the actual dissipation, equality allowed.
Minimum required rating = 2 × 0.132 W = 0.264 W.
Available ratings evaluated:
- 0.125 W: 0.125 W < 0.264 W → fails.
- 0.250 W: 0.250 W < 0.264 W → fails.
- 0.500 W: 0.500 W ≥ 0.264 W → passes.
Smallest passing rating: 0.500 W.

Final selection: 330 Ω resistor with a 0.500 W power rating.
